test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

She looked ____________ (luminous) in the diamond necklace.
solution: The correct answer is '**resplendent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**luminous**' is '**resplendent**'. • **Luminous**: that shines in the dark. (अँधेरे में चमकने वाला) • *Example: a **luminous** watch...* • **Resplendent**: brightly coloured in an attractive and impressive way. (आकर्षक ढंग से चमकीला; दमकता हुआ, चमचमाता हुआ; देदीप्यमान) • *Example: My mother looked **resplendent** in a red silk sari.* **​Correct Answer:__** *resplendent.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **impudent**: very rude; lacking respect and not polite. (बहुत अशिष्‍ट; आदरभाव और नम्रता से रहित, निर्लज्ज) • **strident**: (used about a voice or a sound) loud and unpleasant. [(स्‍वर या ध्वनि) तीव्र और कर्णकटु; कानफोड़ू, तीक्ष्‍ण] • **transcendent**: beyond or above the range of normal or physical human experience. (उत्कृष्ट) 3b:T50e, The correct answer is **'Very rare'.**
